mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indexes
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) signal a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE < 5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals reduced supply chain pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) above 400 billion dollars signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending indexes
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > 400B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 250) signal a balanced monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL < 250, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4%) signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market and recession indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of non-recessionary instances when UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 18000 billion dollars signals reduced economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 18000B, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
